description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git-http-backend' functionality. It defines functions for running HTTP GET and POST requests against a Git server endpoint, checks server responses, and compares expected versus actual output for different repository configurations and access permissions.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified Git repository endpoint and compares the response status line with the expected status.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with specified data and headers to the Git repository endpoint, then compares the response status line with the expected status.
